assessments.reasoning: The JVM core definition documents swap! as atomically installing a value computed by applying the supplied function to the atom’s current value and any additional arguments. Its contract permits repeated function calls. Each listed arity delegates to the atom’s swap method.

challenge.method: Check whether atomicity promises exactly one callback invocation or exactly one external side effect.
challenge.results: The contract explicitly allows repeated invocation, so a single atomic update can involve multiple callback evaluations. The wrapper establishes the API attribution. The passage supplies no observed retry count or exactly-once side-effect guarantee.

limitations: The result concerns atom updates through this API. It supplies no exactly-once guarantee for the update function's side effects.
